text:
Priya Kumar: Ok folks — finalizing run-of-show for the webinar next Wed. Need speaker confirmations + demo fallback plan.
Ethan Lee: I can confirm slides + panel talking points. Will share by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: I can do the live demo. Quick check: we have a recorded fallback if infra flaps, right?
Priya Kumar: yes — recorded demo + short clip of metrics (30s) ready as fallback. @Li Wei will handle the stream fallback routing.
Li Wei (ops): Confirmed. I'll set up a staged recording in the same region as the live infra and a static video link that can be swapped in the OBS scene.
Jon Patel: For the demo prompts, are we using the canonical eval suite or a trimmed set for time?
Ethan Lee: Trimmed set — 6 prompts: 2 generation, 2 chat flows, 2 retrieval/embeddings. Keeps it under 8 mins.
Maya Chen: sharing demo checklist: 1) model pinned to v2.1; 2) API key with dedicated capacity; 3) cold start warmup (10 requests). I'll paste the script below.
Maya Chen: ```
00:00 - Intro (Priya)
03:00 - Product narrative + benchmarks (Ethan)
10:00 - Live demo (Maya)
18:00 - Panel discussion + Qs (Jon + panel)
25:00 - CTA / lead routing (Priya)
```
Priya Kumar: That looks good. Can we add a 2-min buffer after demo for quick recover/segue?
Maya Chen: added buffer, noted.
Li Wei (ops): Streaming checklist: RTMP OK, recording retention 30 days, backup stream to S3 link, stage credentials in 1Password. I'll post infra notes in #eng-infra.
Jon Patel: Lead routing: how are we sending registrant/event leads? Marketo webhook or SFDC?
Ethan Lee: Primary: Marketo for nurturing. Secondary: SFDC for sales ops. We'll tag leads by intent (demo-requests / evaluation).
Priya Kumar: Routing rules: if attendee asks for dedicated deployment or enterprise SLA -> SFDC; otherwise Marketo nurture. Also capture "model of interest" field.
Maya Chen: rehearsals — can we do two dry runs? 1) content + slides, 2) full run with stream and recording. I prefer Wed morning and Fri afternoon.
Ethan Lee: Wed 11am PT works for content dry run. Fri 3pm PT for full run. Calendar invites coming.
MarketingBot: Calendar created: Webinar "Serving LLMs at Scale — Runbook & Demo"; dry run Wed 11:00 PT; full run Fri 15:00 PT. Invite sent to participants.
Li Wei (ops): On rehearsal day, please run `curl` warmup command 10x from staging to ensure KV cache warms: `for i in {1..10}; do curl -sS -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}'; done`
Priya Kumar: Good call. @Jon can you confirm panelists order and one-sentence bios we can use in the slide deck?
Jon Patel: Panel order: Maya (dev lead, demo), Ethan (benchmarks), Sanaa (customer success), Omar (platform). I'll DM Sanaa and Omar for bios; need by Thursday EOD.
Ethan Lee: Also: recording and transcript to be auto-uploaded. QA team to grab 10 highlight clips for social.
Maya Chen: I'll prepare 2 short callouts for the end slide: 1) Try a free eval on Dedicated; 2) Request a performance review.
Priya Kumar: Perfect. Action items: Ethan - slides & benchmarks by Fri EOD; Maya - demo script & warmups; Li Wei - stream fallback + infra notes; Jon - bios. We'll reconvene after Wed dry run. Thanks all! :rocket:
